steps.text:
**NBA Draft Picks (2015 – 2024) Born in the First Week of August (1 – 7 Aug)  
who have averaged more than 15 PPG in at least one NBA season**

| Year | Player | Birth‑date | Draft pick | NBA seasons with 15 PPG+ | Career‑high PPG |
|------|--------|------------|------------|--------------------------|-----------------|
| 2015 | **Kristaps Porzingis** | Aug 2 1995 | 4th overall – New York Knicks | 2019‑20, 2020‑21, 2021‑22, 2022‑23, 2023‑24 | 19.7 ppg (2020‑21) |
| 2015 | **D’Angelo Russell** | Aug 6 1996 | 2nd overall – Los Angeles Lakers | 2017‑18, 2018‑19 | 19.2 ppg (2017‑18) |
| 2020 | **Anthony Edwards** | Aug 5 2001 | 45th overall (2nd round) – Minnesota Timberwolves | 2021‑22, 2022‑23, 2023‑24 | 19.5 ppg (2022‑23) |

---

### Quick Notes

* **Kristaps Porzingis** (born Aug 2) moved to the New York Knicks in 2015.  He posted 19.7 ppg during the 2020‑21 season and has been a 15‑plus‑point scorer in every full season since the 2019‑20 campaign.
* **D’Angelo Russell** (born Aug 6) was the 2nd‑overall pick by the Lakers in 2015.  He first broke the 15‑point mark with a 19.2 ppg average in 2017‑18 and again in 2018‑19 (15.3 ppg).
* **Anthony Edwards** (born Aug 5) was a 2nd‑round pick in 2020 by the Minnesota Timberwolves.  He surpassed 15 ppg in 2021‑22 (15.2 ppg) and has remained a 15‑plus scorer every season since (2022‑23 19.5 ppg, 2023‑24 20.6 ppg).

No other players drafted between 2015 and the 2024 draft pick had a birth‑date in the first week of August **and** recorded a season with an average of more than 15 PPG.
